manifest.source: GitHub GraphQL merged PR search, UTC-day pagination
limitations: GitHub search may be updated after this snapshot.
Reviews are latest per reviewer; earlier review rounds are not captured.
Private work, usage analytics, and unlinked deployment results are unavailable.
manifest.wpr_note: Estimated weighted PR review load from file diffs; slush-branch residual subtraction is not available in this snapshot. The attention marker uses the mature (28+ days) upper-quartile load and lower-half observed impact among authors with at least 10 merged PRs.
